whyThisIsAFalsePositive: The gate exists to stop the factory filling a document a court says is not the filing copy. Its own module comment states the rule it is built on: 'Every pattern here is a phrase that describes the DOCUMENT.' The subject of this sentence is not the document. It is the paragraph above it, which explains the effect of a pardon; the sentence is an ordinary legal-advice disclaimer of that explanation.

SFN 61663 is unambiguously the thing the participant sends. It carries 36 fill-in widgets and a signature line; it prints three addresses to send the completed form to (fax 701-328-6780, P.O. Box 1898 Bismarck, pardonclerk@nd.gov); and it says 'If you fail to complete this application in full, including the needed attachments, it will be returned to you, which could result in a postponement of your hearing.' A document that is returned for being incomplete is a document meant to be completed.

The repository's own census agrees: route-obligation-candidate.json records SFN-61663 as this route's primary_filing, and MASTER_QUEUE has the family SOURCE_READY with implementationStrategy official_pdf_fill.

The pattern's true targets are the North Carolina Spanish translations, which print 'THIS FORM IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM FOR FILING.' Those say it about themselves. This form does not.

whatThisLaneDidNotDoAboutIt: It did not narrow the shared detector. scripts/rcap-official-forms/ is shared machinery: this one pattern governs every family in the factory, other lanes are building against it right now, and narrowing a safety gate that prevents filling a do-not-file document is a change that needs its own tests and its own author rather than a side effect of one family's build.

It did not pass a value to bypass the hold. finalizeOfficialForm reads `nonFilingNotice ?? detectNonFilingNotice(...)`, so passing false would slip past the gate on nullish-coalescing semantics. That is an accident of the expression and not an API for clearing a document.

It did not filter the disclaimer out of the text handed to the detector. The finalizer takes documentTextLines expressly so the hold rests on the document's own words rather than the caller's reading of them; withholding the line would defeat the gate while appearing to satisfy it.
rows.whatWouldUnblockIt: a deliberate narrowing of the informational_purposes_only pattern so it matches only where the sentence's subject is the document — for example requiring 'this form is for informational purposes only' rather than the bare phrase — made by the owner of scripts/rcap-official-forms/, with the North Carolina Spanish translations kept as the regression case. The builder in this commit is complete and will produce the packet unchanged the moment the gate is narrowed.
